title: xppautX .odex options
description: The options block of a .odex model: options { group: { key: value, ... }, ... }. Generated from core/model_options.cpp by xppautX --options-schema; the JSON form of the block's dictionary. A key marked x-repeatable may be written more than once; a path or a text is a double-quoted string, sliders a list of presets, curves a list of curves, every other value one bare word.

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: The animation file the window plays beside a run.

total_time.title: Total time
total_time.description: How long a run integrates, in model time.

start_time.title: Start time
start_time.description: The time a run starts at.

dt.title: Dt
dt.description: The time step of a fixed-step method, and the first step of an adaptive one.

store_every.title: Store every N steps
store_every.description: Keep one step of every this many in the data table.

store_from.title: Store from
store_from.description: Keep no data before this time; the run before it is a transient.

storage_precision.title: Storage precision
storage_precision.description: What the data table keeps each value as: a single-precision float as XPPAUT does, or the integrator's double.

state_limit.title: State limit
state_limit.description: A state beyond plus or minus this value stops the run.

stop_at_limit.title: Stop at the limit
stop_at_limit.description: Whether a state beyond the state limit stops the run, or only marks it.

subsystem_split.title: Subsystem split
subsystem_split.description: What splits the model into independent subsystems: its equations alone, or also the run (a Poincare section or stop).

compile.title: Compile
compile.description: Whether the equations run as compiled code or in the interpreter; a change applies when the model next loads.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed of the random numbers a run draws; the same seed gives the same run.

step.relative_tolerance.title: Relative tolerance
step.relative_tolerance.description: The relative error an adaptive method accepts in one step.

step.absolute_tolerance.title: Absolute tolerance
step.absolute_tolerance.description: The absolute error an adaptive method accepts in one step.

step.min.title: Minimum step
step.min.description: The smallest step an adaptive method takes before it gives up.

step.max.title: Maximum step
step.max.description: The largest step an adaptive method takes.

jacobian.kind.title: Jacobian
jacobian.kind.description: Whether an implicit method gets the Jacobian by differences or from the exact derivatives.

jacobian.band_upper.title: Jacobian band upper
jacobian.band_upper.description: The diagonals above the main one that a banded Jacobian keeps.

jacobian.band_lower.title: Jacobian band lower
jacobian.band_lower.description: The diagonals below the main one that a banded Jacobian keeps.

delay.max_delay.title: Maximal delay
delay.max_delay.description: The longest delay a model uses; it sets how much history is kept.

delay.history_points.title: Delay history points
delay.history_points.description: How many past points of the history a delay model keeps.

delay.real_guess.title: Delay real guess
delay.real_guess.description: The largest real part the search for a delay equilibrium's eigenvalues looks for.

delay.imaginary_guess.title: Delay imaginary guess
delay.imaginary_guess.description: The largest imaginary part the search for a delay equilibrium's eigenvalues looks for.

delay.grid.title: Delay grid
delay.grid.description: How many points a side the grid of a delay equilibrium's eigenvalue search has.

euler.tolerance.title: Newton tolerance
euler.tolerance.description: The Newton tolerance of the implicit Euler method.

euler.iterations.title: Newton iterations
euler.iterations.description: The most Newton iterations the implicit Euler method makes in a step.

bvp.max_iterates.title: BVP maximum iterates
bvp.max_iterates.description: The most Newton iterates a boundary value solve makes.

bvp.tolerance.title: BVP tolerance
bvp.tolerance.description: The tolerance a boundary value solve stops at.

bvp.epsilon.title: BVP epsilon
bvp.epsilon.description: The step that differences the boundary value problem's Jacobian.

torus.period.title: Torus period
torus.period.description: The period of the variables that live on a circle or torus.

torus.fold.title: Torus fold
torus.fold.description: A variable that is taken modulo the torus period; each names one.

map.title: Map
map.description: What a run records at a Poincare section: nothing, the section, the maxima or the period.

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: The variable the Poincare section is taken on.

sign.title: Sign
sign.description: Which crossings of the section count: upward, downward or both.

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: The value of the variable at the section.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Whether a crossing of the section stops the run.

max_iterations.title: Equilibria: maximum iterations
max_iterations.description: The most Newton iterations the search for an equilibrium makes.

newton_tolerance.title: Equilibria: Newton tolerance
newton_tolerance.description: The tolerance the search for an equilibrium stops at.

jacobian_step.title: Equilibria: Jacobian step
jacobian_step.description: The step that differences the Jacobian of the equilibrium search.

search_limit.title: Equilibria: search limit
search_limit.description: A state beyond plus or minus this value ends the equilibrium search.

print_eigenvalues.title: Equilibria: print eigenvalues
print_eigenvalues.description: Whether the eigenvalues of an equilibrium are printed.

draw_invariant_sets.title: Equilibria: draw invariant sets
draw_invariant_sets.description: Whether the stable and unstable sets of a saddle are drawn.

draw_strong_sets.title: Equilibria: draw strong sets
draw_strong_sets.description: Whether the strong stable and unstable sets are drawn.

near_tolerance.title: Near tolerance
near_tolerance.description: How close two values must be for the model's near function to call them equal.

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: The parameter or variable a sweep varies.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: How many steps the sweep makes between its ends.

low.title: Low
low.description: The value the sweep starts at.

high.title: High
high.description: The value the sweep ends at.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Whether each run of the sweep starts from the initial conditions.

old_ic.title: Old ic
old_ic.description: Whether each run of the sweep starts where the one before ended.

write_files.title: Write files
write_files.description: Whether each run of the sweep is written to a file of its own.

mesh_intervals.title: Mesh intervals
mesh_intervals.description: How many mesh intervals a periodic orbit or boundary value solution has.

max_steps.title: Max steps
max_steps.description: The most continuation steps a run takes before it stops.

output_every.title: Output every
output_every.description: A diagram point is kept every this many steps.

collocation_points.title: Collocation points
collocation_points.description: The collocation points in each mesh interval.

parameter_min.title: Parameter min
parameter_min.description: A continuation run stops when the parameter falls below this.

parameter_max.title: Parameter max
parameter_max.description: A continuation run stops when the parameter rises above this.

norm_min.title: Norm min
norm_min.description: A continuation run stops when the solution's norm falls below this.

norm_max.title: Norm max
norm_max.description: A continuation run stops when the solution's norm rises above this.

parameter_tolerance.title: Parameter tolerance
parameter_tolerance.description: The tolerance the parameter converges to in the Newton iteration.

state_tolerance.title: State tolerance
state_tolerance.description: The tolerance the state converges to in the Newton iteration.

special_point_tolerance.title: Special point tolerance
special_point_tolerance.description: The tolerance the special points of a branch are located to.

mesh_adapt_every.title: Mesh adapt every
mesh_adapt_every.description: The mesh is adapted every this many steps; 0 keeps it as it is.

max_branch_switches.title: Max branch switches
max_branch_switches.description: The most times a run switches to another branch.

switch_one_direction.title: Switch one direction
switch_one_direction.description: Whether a branch switch continues in one direction only.

output_detail.title: Output detail
output_detail.description: How much of each point the run writes to the Output.

max_location_iterations.title: Max location iterations
max_location_iterations.description: The most iterations that locate a special point.

max_newton_iterations.title: Max newton iterations
max_newton_iterations.description: The most Newton iterations in one continuation step.

full_newton_after.title: Full newton after
full_newton_after.description: A full Newton iteration is taken after this many steps; before it the Jacobian is kept.

step_adapt_every.title: Step adapt every
step_adapt_every.description: The step size is adapted every this many steps.

suppress_branch_points.title: Suppress branch points
suppress_branch_points.description: Whether branch points are left out of the diagram.

follow_all_branches.title: Follow all branches
follow_all_branches.description: Whether a run follows every branch it finds, not only the one it started on.

special_points.title: Special points
special_points.description: The codimension-two points a run detects: a comma-separated list of their names, empty for none.

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: The variable the continuation diagram plots up.

x_min.title: X min
x_min.description: The left edge of the continuation diagram.

x_max.title: X max
x_max.description: The right edge of the continuation diagram.

y_min.title: Y min
y_min.description: The bottom edge of the continuation diagram.

y_max.title: Y max
y_max.description: The top edge of the continuation diagram.

colors.stable_equilibrium.title: Colors stable equilibrium
colors.stable_equilibrium.description: The colour of the stable equilibria in the diagram.

colors.unstable_equilibrium.title: Colors unstable equilibrium
colors.unstable_equilibrium.description: The colour of the unstable equilibria in the diagram.

colors.stable_periodic.title: Colors stable periodic
colors.stable_periodic.description: The colour of the stable periodic orbits in the diagram.

colors.unstable_periodic.title: Colors unstable periodic
colors.unstable_periodic.description: The colour of the unstable periodic orbits in the diagram.

colormap.title: Colormap
colormap.description: The colours a colour-coded curve or an array plot runs through.

curves.title: Curves
curves.description: The curves of the starting graph, each with the variables on its axes; the first holds the axes' variables.

axes.x_low.title: Axes x low
axes.x_low.description: The left edge of the two-dimensional window.

axes.x_high.title: Axes x high
axes.x_high.description: The right edge of the two-dimensional window.

axes.y_low.title: Axes y low
axes.y_low.description: The bottom edge of the two-dimensional window.

axes.y_high.title: Axes y high
axes.y_high.description: The top edge of the two-dimensional window.

axes.x_min.title: Axes x min
axes.x_min.description: The low end of the three-dimensional box in x.

axes.x_max.title: Axes x max
axes.x_max.description: The high end of the three-dimensional box in x.

axes.y_min.title: Axes y min
axes.y_min.description: The low end of the three-dimensional box in y.

axes.y_max.title: Axes y max
axes.y_max.description: The high end of the three-dimensional box in y.

axes.z_min.title: Axes z min
axes.z_min.description: The low end of the three-dimensional box in z.

axes.z_max.title: Axes z max
axes.z_max.description: The high end of the three-dimensional box in z.

axes.phi.title: Axes phi
axes.phi.description: The azimuth the three-dimensional plot is viewed from, in degrees.

axes.theta.title: Axes theta
axes.theta.description: The elevation the three-dimensional plot is viewed from, in degrees.

line.draw.title: Line draw
line.draw.description: Whether a new curve is drawn as a line, as points or as both.

line.dash.title: Line dash
line.dash.description: The dash pattern of a new curve's line.

line.width.title: Line width
line.width.description: The width of a new curve's line.

line.marker.title: Line marker
line.marker.description: The marker drawn at the points of a new curve.

line.marker_size.title: Line marker size
line.marker_size.description: The size of the markers of a new curve.

nullclines.mesh.title: Nullcline mesh
nullclines.mesh.description: How many points a side the nullclines are found on.

nullclines.draw.title: Nullclines draw
nullclines.draw.description: Whether the nullclines are drawn after a run.

nullclines.x_color.title: Nullclines x color
nullclines.x_color.description: The colour of the x nullcline.

nullclines.y_color.title: Nullclines y color
nullclines.y_color.description: The colour of the y nullcline.

direction_field.grid.title: Direction field grid
direction_field.grid.description: How many arrows a side the direction field has.

direction_field.draw.title: Direction field draw
direction_field.draw.description: What a run draws of the direction field, and whether it also saves it.

manifolds.stable_color.title: Manifolds stable color
manifolds.stable_color.description: The colour of the stable manifold of a saddle.

manifolds.unstable_color.title: Manifolds unstable color
manifolds.unstable_color.description: The colour of the unstable manifold of a saddle.

color_by.enabled.title: Color by enabled
color_by.enabled.description: Whether a curve is coloured by a quantity along it.

color_by.via.title: Color by via
color_by.via.description: The variable a colour-coded curve takes its colour from.

color_by.low.title: Color by low
color_by.low.description: The value of the colouring variable that gets the first colour.

color_by.high.title: Color by high
color_by.high.description: The value of the colouring variable that gets the last colour.

histogram.low.title: Histogram low
histogram.low.description: The low end of the histogram's range.

histogram.high.title: Histogram high
histogram.high.description: The high end of the histogram's range.

histogram.bins.title: Histogram bins
histogram.bins.description: How many bins the histogram has.

histogram.column.title: Histogram column
histogram.column.description: The column of the data the histogram counts.

histogram2.low.title: Histogram2 low
histogram2.low.description: The low end of the second axis of the two-dimensional histogram.

histogram2.high.title: Histogram2 high
histogram2.high.description: The high end of the second axis of the two-dimensional histogram.

histogram2.bins.title: Histogram2 bins
histogram2.bins.description: How many bins the second axis of the two-dimensional histogram has.

histogram2.column.title: Histogram2 column
histogram2.column.description: The column on the second axis of the two-dimensional histogram.

spectrum.column.title: Spectrum column
spectrum.column.description: The column of the data the spectrum is taken of.

spectrum.column2.title: Spectrum column2
spectrum.column2.description: The second column of a cross spectrum or a coherence.

spectrum.width.title: Spectrum width
spectrum.width.description: How many points the spectrum's windows are long.

spectrum.window.title: Spectrum window
spectrum.window.description: The window the spectrum's segments are weighted with.

format.title: Format
format.description: The vector format a picture is exported in.

color.title: Color
color.description: Whether an exported picture is in colour.

font_size.title: Font size
font_size.description: The font size of an exported picture.

sliders.title: Sliders
sliders.description: The sliders the window offers: a parameter or variable each, with its range.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: The buttons of the window, each running a command or a set.

data_file.title: Data file
data_file.description: The file a run writes its data to, named from the model's folder.

run_set.title: Run set
run_set.description: A set a batch run runs, by its name; repeat the option for each set. With none, every set runs.

nullclines_file.title: Nullclines file
nullclines_file.description: The file the nullclines are saved to after a run.

after_run.title: After run
after_run.description: What a batch run makes of its data once it has run: an analysis, or the mean or variance of its runs.

after_run_file.title: After run file
after_run_file.description: The file the after_run analysis is written to, so the data file keeps the trajectory.
